_comment: Curation source-of-truth for the 'AI Data Center Buildout' sidebar chart, consumed by capex_collector.py. Ordering here is only a hint; the collector re-sorts by value descending. For public:true companies the collector fetches trailing-12-mo capex live from SEC EDGAR; add value/estimated/source/basis/as_of to override the live figure (e.g. a data-center-only estimate). public:false rows (value, source URL, as_of required) are supported, but private AI labs are intentionally excluded: they disclose only multi-year commitments and mostly rent compute from the public companies here, so their spend would be double-counted.
